title: Migrate optimizer and task artifacts to GraphQLArtifactStore
description:
Purpose: Remove default AWS credential requirements from optimizer and task artifact paths.

Owned scope:
- Optimizer manifests, event logs, runtime logs, and final artifacts.
- Task output attachments.
- Remaining API-key-only conditionals in optimizer, progress tracking, MCP, and procedure control paths that are part of the local workflow.

Acceptance:
- Optimizer artifacts and task output remain visible through existing dashboard pointers.
- Core-path tests make boto3.client for S3 raise and still pass.
- Existing artifact metadata remains readable.
- No silent storage or authentication fallback remains.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Kickoff: canonical agent /root/aws_login_auth in /Users/ryan.porter/Projects/Plexus-aws-login-free-optimizer-task on codex/aws-login-free-optimizer-task, based on 06d9af09a8bf5ed3cb25535fdeb06c0a14a1e3e2. Owned scope: GraphQLArtifactStore migration for optimizer manifests/events/runtime/final artifacts and task output attachments, plus local-workflow API-key-only conditionals in optimizer/progress/MCP/procedure control. Dependency boundary: consume the centralized explicit Cognito/IAM dashboard-client modes and GraphQLArtifactStore; do not modify their owning lanes, add direct S3, introduce credential fallbacks, or alter Tactus at runtime. Behavior tests will first prove persistence while boto3.client('s3') fails.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Migrated task-output and optimizer artifacts to GraphQL-authorized HTTPS transfers; direct S3 client use is blocked in regression tests. Local client factory now selects Cognito interactively, IAM in Lambda, and honors explicit mode. Focused suite: 90 passed.
